Rebuild the actual COMSOL mesh from M0 in an isolated copy; no postprocessing grid substitution and no double-application onto M1 or M2.

physical_comparison.scientific_summary: Four-mesh M0/M1/M2/M3 native-mesh sensitivity at unchanged rtol=1e-4 and const maximum internal time step 0.05 s, with M2/M3 as the primary adjacent 1% gate: INSENSITIVE_WITHIN_TESTED_RANGE. Non-uniform unstructured mesh scaling does not establish a formal asymptotic GCI or an exact-solution error bound; four-level trends are reported directly without extrapolation.

m0_vs_m1.scientific_summary: Tightening solver tolerance strategy by 10x (rtol 1e-3 -> 1e-4) resulted in 1.00x internal steps (4093 vs 4091) and N/A compute time (UNOBTAINEDs vs 220.30611509999653s). Over the last 5 verified stable cycles, all 4 physical indicators changed by: St: +0.9015% (tol 1.0%), Mean Cd: +0.4885% (tol 1.0%), Lift Amplitude: +2.7054% (tol 1.0%), De-meaned RMS: +2.7374% (tol 1.0%). Overall Conclusion: SENSITIVE (Sensitive reasons: ['Lift amp change (+2.705%) exceeds tolerance (1.0%)', 'Lift RMS change (+2.737%) exceeds tolerance (1.0%)']). Note: Insensitivity within this tested tolerance range does NOT imply full time-step independence or grid independence; subsequent tests must evaluate explicit internal step constraints.
